verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a bulk-edit capability, such as multi-select actions in the UI or a bulk update or delete API endpoint. The REST API is a general building block, and the listed endpoints act on single items (e.g., create or delete one Category). The Iteration automation that moves unfinished Stories forward and the CSV/Jira import are adjacent features, not general bulk operations across many items.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
